title: The World Before (HKAFF)
synopsis:
Seven years after Moving On at 16th HKAFF, her acclaimed debut and winner of the New Talent Award, Yoon Dan-bi returns with a tender coming-of-age story set on a remote Korean island. Seventeen-year-old Jin has never known another world. When childhood friend Dujae returns for his grandmother's funeral, she begins finding small reasons to see him. What starts as the ease of childhood gradually gives way to first love. With rare sensitivity to adolescence, Yoon captures how a first flicker of affection ripples outward, gathering into a wave of feeling that sweeps everything else away. First love, first heartbreak, first glimpse of the world beyond.

 

Toronto International Film Festival

synopsis_lang.zh_hk:
以首作《讓我們走下去》榮獲第16屆HKAFF亞洲新導演獎的尹丹菲，睽違七年帶來細膩動人的青春日誌。17歲少女珍成長於偏遠小島，仍像孩子般澄澈，對島外天地甚是陌生。當青梅竹馬斗宰因祖母喪禮歸來暫住，珍總找盡微小藉口去見他，成為他的依靠。面對心事重重的少年，兩小無猜的自然熟稔，悄然化作初戀的局促不安與強烈悸動。隨着盛夏流逝，少女的情愫默默重塑了她如夢的海島，在熟悉的風景褪色之際，終將走出最初的世界，看見蛻變中的自己。

 

多倫多國際電影節
